# Agent Changelog

> A small site that tracks the release history of agent CLIs and frameworks, one page per
> tracked project, rebuilt from their own GitHub Releases. The sync is **manual**: there is no
> cron in this repository — running the `Sync Changelog` workflow (or `node scripts/sync.mjs`)
> fetches the releases, parses their notes and rewrites the data file the pages load.

## Pages

- Landing page: https://alloevil.github.io/agent-changelog/
- OpenClaw changelog: https://alloevil.github.io/agent-changelog/openclaw.html
- Hermes Agent changelog: https://alloevil.github.io/agent-changelog/hermes.html
- Source and how to run the sync: https://github.com/alloevil/agent-changelog

## What is checkable

- Published numbers, and the command that recomputes each: `claims.json` in the repository root.
- The tests compare the landing page's figures against the data files the pages actually load, so
  a stale card fails CI instead of ageing quietly.

## Scope

- Only projects whose releases are public on GitHub; a project is added by adding a fetcher.
- The pages show upstream release notes as published upstream, with the date and version attached.
